77966.subject: 🥊 Nvidia pays $6B to take down DeepSeek
77966.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Nvidia is reportedly spending $6 billion to build an American answer to DeepSeek. WikiHow is taking OpenAI to court over its how-to articles, Anthropic's job interview asks recruits about a worthless stock, and Bernie Sanders says the country came around to stopping AI.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Nvidia:** What is it buying for $6 billion?

* **OpenAI:** Who's dragging it to court now?

* **Anthropic:** What does it ask before hiring you?

* **Bernie:** Why is he claiming victory over AI?


----------



----------
## Nvidia pays $6B to take down DeepSeek

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e1379ca0-9c41-4434-9681-1cb7abc82875/hf_20260824_212104_57f96f3c-a3f0-4f73-aa48-6869b36d2abd.png?t=1787606581)
Caption: 

Nvidia is reportedly paying $6 billion to [license Poolside's technology](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/nvidia-is-spending-6-billion-to-build-a-powerful-u-s-alternative-to-chinese-ai-c51c38cc), per the Wall Street Journal, plus about $1 billion invested in the startup at a $12 billion valuation. More than 100 Poolside engineers move over to work on Nemotron, Nvidia's open-weight model project.

The target is obvious. DeepSeek, Kimi K3 and Qwen turned open-weight AI into a Chinese home game, with Kimi shipping 2.8 trillion parameters for free last month while American labs kept their best weights locked.

Nvidia doesn’t like that.

The strategy pays twice, since every open model tuned for Nvidia hardware sells more Nvidia hardware. Yesterday's spending data showed businesses picking cheap open models. That's the market Nvidia just bid to own.




----------

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
